description: [$x402 pay-per-call] Generates cryptographically random passwords using the OS CSPRNG.

count.description: Number of passwords to generate (1-20). Default: 1.

x_payment.description: Optional. Signed x402 payment header (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT) from the caller. If omitted, returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements.

name: dev_tools_password_generate
